reviews.comment: Stopped in on a road trip and wish we lived closer. The morning bun and an oat flat white were perfect.
The staff member at the till was pretty short with me when I asked about nut-free options. Food was fine but I felt rushed.
Great bread, cute space. They ran out of baguettes by 11am, so get there early!
Ordered sourdough for our wedding brunch and it was the hit of the day.

reviewReply.comment: Congratulations Amy! We were honoured to be part of your day.
